//: Tailscale Serve config for the smcity sidecar. Proxies https://smcity.<your-tailnet>.ts.net/ to the agent container's port 8080 over the docker bridge network. The agent container is reachable by its compose service name 'smcity-agent'. To flip on public-internet exposure via Funnel, set the AllowFunnel value below to true AND make sure Funnel is enabled on the tailnet at https://login.tailscale.com/admin/dns.
